asks.title: What should happen with the encampment behind Under One Roof?
asks.why: An encampment has grown behind Squamish’s only shelter building on Third Avenue. Council and BC Housing are deciding what happens next.
labels: Clear it once temporary housing opens
Let people stay with more support

asks.title: Put the modular shelter somewhere other than the park near Junction Park
asks.why: More than 290 residents signed a petition in April 2026 asking for a different site for the provincial modular housing. They don't oppose the program itself.

asks.title: What should happen with the supportive housing planned at 39900 Government Road?
asks.why: BC Housing plans six storeys with 65 studio homes and support staff around the clock, run by Squamish Helping Hands.

asks.title: Install the defibrillator at the Brennan Park pickleball and tennis courts this year
asks.why: Pickleball Squamish offered up to $4,000 toward it. A June 2026 staff report scheduled it for 2027.

asks.title: When should Squamish build more pickleball courts?
asks.why: In March 2026 staff asked council to hold off on new courts until the 2027 Parks and Recreation Master Plan looks at racket sports.

asks.title: Fix up the Eaglewind courts and reopen them for tennis
asks.why: The courts have sat unused since pickleball moved to Brennan Park in 2023 and 2024. Staff recommended fixing them up.

asks.title: What should Brennan Park add next?
asks.why: Brennan Park has the town’s only arena and only public pool. A second rink and a second pool are both in the District’s long term vision, with no money set aside yet.
labels: Both, even if taxes go up

asks.title: Fence the off leash dog area at John Hunter Park
asks.why: John Hunter Park is one of the off leash pilot sites. The District says it still needs a fence, with no timeline set.

asks.title: Upgrade the Brennan Park disc golf course
asks.why: Residents asked for an upgraded disc golf course in the 2021 feedback on the Brennan Park plan.

asks.title: Build covered outdoor basketball courts
asks.why: Residents asked for covered outdoor courts in the 2021 feedback on the Brennan Park plan, so they can be used in the rain.

asks.title: Add a crosswalk and a wider bike lane on Highlands Way North, south of Pentland Way
asks.why: Speeding in the school zone. It is on the District's 2026 traffic calming list.

asks.title: Put speed humps on Upper Mamquam Road
asks.why: Speeding and truck traffic. It is on the District's 2026 traffic calming list.

asks.title: Put a raised crosswalk and new signs on Skyline Drive
asks.why: It is on the District's 2026 traffic calming list.

asks.title: Make the Highway 99 and Cleveland Avenue intersection safer
asks.why: The District says it has the highest crash rate in town. The Province runs the highway, so council's role is to press for changes.

asks.title: Should downtown parking stay free?
asks.why: A 2023 study suggested paid parking downtown. Council chose to test it at Darrell Bay only.
labels: Paid only in the busiest spots

asks.title: Should Squamish help pay for a bus to Vancouver and Whistler?
asks.why: Squamish has local buses but no public bus to Vancouver or Whistler. It has been studied since 2015 and has stalled over who runs and pays for it.
labels: Yes, even with a small tax increase

asks.title: How much should property taxes go up in 2027?
asks.why: Property taxes rose 12.8% in 2026. Council is working on the 2027 budget now.

asks.title: How should Squamish speed up dike upgrades?
asks.why: Much of Squamish sits on a floodplain. The District raises dikes a section at a time, mostly when grants come through.
